# Extra words for the glide-typing word list (AT1): web names, modern words and the apostrophe words. A word that is already in the frequency list gets AT LEAST this count; an unknown one is added.
# Format: word count. Counts are on the scale of the frequency list (the = 23 billion). Written by hand for this project; no outside licence applies to this file.
